NOEMI

In twelve days my father is giving me to a man who wears his dead wives' wedding rings on his little finger.

There's one way out. One man in Philadelphia that monster won't go to war with.

He's my family's enemy. The city calls him the Saint, because he never raises his voice and never misses Mass, and because the men who cross him end up in the river.

So I walk into his club with a pawnshop ring and ask him to marry me.

He says yes before I can lose my nerve.

His terms are simple. His house. His name. His bed.

Mine is simpler. No sex.

He just looks at me across the table and tells me I'll beg.

SANTINO

For eleven years I've wanted one thing. Her father in the ground.

Then his daughter sits down at my table and hands me the only door into his house.

I'm not a good man. I've never pretended to be. I married her for a reason she would never forgive, and I'm keeping her for reasons I refuse to say out loud.

Every man in this city knows better than to touch what's mine.

Now she's mine.

The war is coming for her. So is the truth. And the one thing I swore I would never do again is want something this badly.

I'll burn South Philly to the ground before I let anything take her from me.

This is the first book in The Vicious Saints Series. Reading order:

Sin.

Vice.

Ruin.
